GN-2.tags: <View el={cam}> and <View el={doc}> from import { camera, pdf, View } from '@markless/device'
mistakes: `<base.button onChange={async () => (photo = await cam.takePhoto())}>Take photo</base.button>`: onChange on a base.button without pressed; the sheet says a button without pressed is plain with no state, and onChange reports the new pressed state of a toggle, so the press is never reported
`<base.button onChange={() => cam.flip()}>`: same, flip button has no pressed, so onChange has no state change to report
`<base.button disabled={doc.page <= 1} onChange={() => (doc.page = doc.page - 1)}>Previous</base.button>`: onChange on a plain base.button
`<base.button ... onChange={() => (doc.page = doc.page + 1)}>Next</base.button>`: onChange on a plain base.button
GN-2.notes: Tags, imports and doc.page/doc.pages use are right; every button relies on onChange from a base.button with no pressed prop. camera() called with no facing (allowed). Judgement call: the sheet types onChange as optional on any base.button but only describes it firing for toggles.
